messages:
Sam H: kicked off a micro-sweep comparing L4 / T4 / A10G for embeddings + small-chat across us-east1, europe-west1, ap-southeast1. posting quick findings. :chart_with_upwards_trend:
Maya R: nice — what model/version and quant settings?
Sam H: model=redwood/mini-chat-1.0; runs: fp16 baseline, q4_0, q8_0 for embeddings and small-chat convo. batch sizes: emb: 1/8/32; chat: 1/4/8.
Jesse L: quick summary pls — p95 and cost-per-1M-tokens?
Sam H: tl;dr:
- L4: best p95 latency for chat at batch=1 (~28ms p50, 85ms p95 in us-east1), but highest $/1M tokens (~$210) because of higher instance price. great for low-latency single-req patterns.
- T4: best cost efficiency for embeddings at larger batch sizes. at emb batch=32, throughput on T4 ~1200 reqs/s, cost ~$45/1M tokens. p95 for chat suffers at batch=1 (~140ms).
- A10G: sweet spot for throughput-latency tradeoff. chat p95 ~95ms (batch=1) and embeddings throughput ~2200 reqs/s (batch=32). cost ~$80/1M tokens.
Elena P: interesting — kernel details? were you using fused attention / flash-attn?
Sam H: on A10G we enabled flash-attn v2 + cuBLAS matmul-fused kernels (runtime flags: --opt-kernel=flash2 --matmul=auto). gave 10-12% p95 improvement for chat over default. On L4 we used the memory-optimized kernels (--kernel=memopt) to avoid OOM with fp16. T4 benefited from int8 GEMM paths for embeddings.
Maya R: how about quant impact on quality? any regressions for small-chat?
Sam H: quant notes:
- q4_0 embeddings: cosine drop mean ~0.0016 vs fp16 (negligible).
- q8_0 embeddings: indistinguishable at our eval set.
- chat q4_0: slight degrade in safety/verbosity heuristics; exact-match on our synthetic QA set down ~0.7%. flagged for follow-up eval.
Jesse L: regional diffs? any network/glb skew?
Sam H: yes — ap-southeast1 had 15-25ms extra network latency vs us-east1 which pushed p95 up. but A10G instances in ap-southeast had slightly better throughput than the local T4s (likely driver/kernel builds).
Elena P: capacity sizing notes? how many concurrent connections per GPU for predictable latency?
Sam H: recommended starting points:
- chat (low-latency): L4 -> 40 concurrent tokens/sec cap per GPU, A10G -> 60, T4 -> avoid < 2 concurrent users per GPU if you need p95<120ms.
- embeddings (high throughput): T4 best when batching to 32+, A10G if you need headroom for mixed workloads.
Maya R: any ops caveats?
Sam H: yes:
- enable KV-cache pinning on A10G for chat to reduce p95 jumps on long sessions.
- T4: monitor memory fragmentation when using q8 paths; restart worker every 12h if fragmentation >60%.
- L4: higher instance price but is easiest to debug for regressions (deterministic kernels).
bench-bot: run 1812349876 completed — attached charts: /internal/bench/1812349876/plots (embeddings_throughput.png, chat_p95_by_region.png) :white_check_mark:
Jesse L: perf looks good. can you drop a short note in the eng-ml bench board with suggested default profiles?
Sam H: will do. plan: default profiles: embeddings -> T4 (batch=32, q8_0); chat low-latency -> L4 (fp16); chat balanced -> A10G (fp16 + flash2). will open PR with config. :memo:
